messages:
alisha: Quick kickoff — proposal for a JSON-mode 'retry orchestration' feature. Not a single retry flag; think of a decision tree: try soft repair -> regex fixes -> model-based repair -> fallback to non-JSON. Need launch criteria, API knobs, and a prioritized plan.

 tom: Sketch of API knobs I imagine: `validation_policy: strict|soft|repair`, `repair_attempts: <int>`, `fallback_mode: error|partial|non_json`, `repair_strategies: [regex, model_edit]`, and `tool_retry_strategy: retry-without-tools|retry-with-tools|no-retry`. Example header: `X-JSON-Handling: repair=1;fallback=non_json`.

 marta: Important: two repair paradigms — model-internal (constrained decoding or an edit model) vs post-hoc heuristic fixes. Post-hoc (regex) is cheap but brittle. Model-repair gives higher quality but needs eval and more tokens. We should prototype both.

 kevin: Runtime note: each repair attempt increases tail latency. Operational defaults matter. Suggest defaults: hosted free=strict(0 repairs), hosted paid=soft(1 repair), enterprise=repair(3). Need P90 latency guard rails and cost estimates per attempt.

 sam_cs: From customers: some want deterministic failure (explicit error + explanation) rather than silent fixes. We should expose an `explain` flag that returns failure reason and the offending fragment. Example: `{"_validation_error":"missing_field 'items' at index 0"}`.

 alisha: MVP proposal: server-side policy + two repair modes (regex-heal + lightweight model-edit POC), opt-in via header/param, and an explain payload when validation fails. Launch criteria: <=5% added P90 latency for typical workloads, docs + SDK snippet, and at least 3 pilot customers opt-in.

 tom: Edge case: tool/function calling. If a tool's output breaks the schema, do we retry the tool call, sanitize the tool output, or skip tools? Suggest a `tool_retry_strategy` policy per-call. Implementation note: if we retry without tools we must surface that in the explain payload.

 marta: We need a labeled eval set for repair quality. Ask ML: create ~500 prompt+schema pairs and inject common corruptions (trailing commas, invalid escapes, mismatched brackets). Run both strategies and compare precision/recall of valid parse + human acceptability.

 kevin: Telemetry we require: `json.validation.failures`, `json.repair.attempts`, `json.repair.success`, `json.fallbacks`, plus `json.latency.added` (histogram). Tie metrics to model variant and customer id for rollout safety.

 alisha: Prioritization draft: 1) API knobs + telemetry + docs, 2) regex-heal repair + pilot, 3) model-edit POC + benchmark, 4) tool interaction rules, 5) rollout automation and customer opt-ins. Resource ask: owners for a 6-week sprint to deliver items 1-3.

 dave: SRE constraints: add a per-customer circuit breaker to stop repair storms (e.g., >10 repairs/min -> auto-disable repair and return explain error). Also rate-limit model-edit attempts.

 tom: I'll draft an RFC w/ API shapes, telemetry schema, and a pilot plan. Will include sample SDK snippet, test plan, and a migration guide for customers who currently parse server responses. ETA: EOW.

 alisha: :thumbsup: assigning owners: tom -> RFC & runtime changes, marta -> eval datasets & model POC, kevin -> telemetry + SLOs, dave -> circuit breakers. I'll gather pilot customer volunteers and draft the docs snippet for SDKs.
